title: Are You Washed in the Blood?
description: Are You Washed in the Blood? in Tonic Solfa to WASHED IN THE BLOOD: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Elisha A. Hoffman wrote the words and the tune WASHED IN THE BLOOD, published in 1878.
underlay: Have you been to Je-sus for the cleans-ing pow’r? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are you ful-ly trust-ing in His grace this hour? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb? Are you washed in the blood, In the soul-cleans-ing blood of the Lamb? Are your gar-ments spot-less? Are they white as snow? Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

lines: Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing pow’r?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul-cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless? Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you walking daily by the Saviour’s side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb;
There’s a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,
Oh, be washed in the blood of the Lamb!
